text: I shall. She’ll never let me hear the end of it otherwise. There. Mrs Baines can have her arm back.
direction: Nora Vale, a 30-year-old English needleworker. Quiet clear and capable voice with a subtle working London accent; occasional dry humour and gentle uncertainty. Light clear mezzo, agile rhythm, soft precise consonants and a small dry lift on a witty observation. Speak with adult confidence, never breathy, childlike or portentous.
